extra.description: arXiv:2608.09934v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents improve task performance by decomposing problems into role-specialized behaviors. However, their practical deployment is often limited by the computational cost and instability associated with the on-the-fly agent design for each user request.
